description: On-demand chart generation for any ticker or strategy. Includes price action charts, indicator overlays, equity curves, and portfolio snapshots. Greg wants a button — not automatic 15-minute generation.
tools: charting library TBD (e.g., mplfinance, lightweight-charts, TradingView webhooks)
frequency: On-demand only (Greg-triggered or via trade proposal)

workflows.name: generate-chart
workflows.description: Generate a chart for a specified ticker / timeframe on demand
workflows.trigger: on-demand (Greg command or trade proposal CTA)
steps: Receive chart request: ticker, timeframe, indicator list, date range
Fetch OHLCV data from Hyper Liquid API
Apply requested indicators (MA, RSI, MACD, volume, etc.)
Send chart image to Greg via Telegram

workflows.name: generate-equity-curve
workflows.description: Visualize backtest results as equity curve chart
workflows.trigger: on-demand (called by back-tester after backtest completion)
steps: Receive equity curve data from backtest output
Render equity curve with drawdown overlay
Send chart image to Greg via Telegram
Attach to backtest report in memory
workflows.output: Equity curve chart image + integration with backtest report
